resources.string: Control Apple Music, Spotify and YouTube Music from one widget.
Start a song in a music app
Relay on: YouTube Music picks, Apple Music plays
The relay needs both Apple Music and YouTube Music
Play a song in YouTube Music first, then tap the badge
Relay off. Tap: YouTube Music picks, Apple Music plays
Relay on. Tap to turn off
No lyrics found for this song
The lyrics service (LRCLIB) is busy. Trying again every 20 seconds…
Couldn\'t load lyrics. Check your internet and tap the lyrics button again.
Play a song to see lyrics
Couldn\'t load details. Check your internet and tap ⓘ again.
Resampled %1$s → %2$s kHz by Android\'s mixer (not bit-perfect)
This app doesn\'t report its stream format.
Android shares what\'s playing (and play/pause/skip controls) only with apps that have notification access. The widget reads nothing else.
Switch greyed out? Tap “Open app info”, then the ⋮ menu (top right) → “Allow restricted settings”, then try again. Android does this for apps installed from a file.
In App info, turn ON “Autostart” and set Battery saver to “No restrictions”. Otherwise HyperOS may stop the widget from updating.
No supported music app installed. Install Apple Music, Spotify or YouTube Music.
Long-press your home screen → Widgets → Music Widget. Or use the button below. Resize it by long-pressing the widget and dragging its edges.
Your launcher can\'t add widgets this way. Long-press the home screen → Widgets instead.

Widget: tap album art to open the player panel.\nPanel: swipe art left/right = next/previous · double-tap = play/pause · tap = lyrics on/off · swipe up = lyrics · ⓘ = song and artist info · swipe down = close · drag the bar to seek · on lyrics: tap a line = jump there, tap elsewhere = back to art.\nBadge (widget and panel): tap = relay on/off (YouTube Music picks, Apple Music plays) · long-press (panel) = open the app.

1. Play a song in one music app.
2. Come back here and tap Search or Link for each OTHER app. Each test pauses the song, starts it in that app, and checks the result. Come back here after each test.
3. Repeat with a song playing in each app.
4. Tap Copy report and paste it to Claude.
Relay: YouTube Music picks → Apple Music plays
